en.summary: The probability of WTI hitting $110 by May 4, 2026, dropped 13% as WTI crude fell 3.06% to $101.85/bbl on May 4, 2026, coupled with reports of global oil oversupply. CNN highlighted producers operating at maximum output with storage constraints, signaling bearish market fundamentals.
drivers: WTI crude fell 3.06% to $101.85/bbl.
Global oil producers at maximum output.
Concerns over crude oil storage capacity.
en.why_matters: Sustained lower oil prices could ease inflationary pressures and impact energy sector profitability, influencing global economic stability.
en.bull_case: Escalating geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, could trigger significant supply disruptions, pushing WTI towards $110.
en.bear_case: Persistent global oversupply and weakening demand, exacerbated by storage issues, will keep WTI below the $110 target.

zh.title: 油价下跌，供应过剩担忧
zh.summary: 2026年5月4日，WTI原油价格下跌3.06%至101.85美元/桶，加上全球原油供应过剩的报道，导致WTI在2026年5月4日当周触及110美元的可能性下降13%。CNN指出产油商已达最大产能且面临储存问题。
drivers: WTI原油下跌3.06%至101.85美元/桶。
全球产油商已达最大产能。
原油储存能力受限的担忧。
zh.why_matters: 油价持续走低可能缓解通胀压力，影响能源行业盈利能力，进而影响全球经济稳定。
zh.bull_case: 中东地缘政治紧张局势升级，可能引发重大供应中断，推动WTI油价升至110美元。
zh.bear_case: 持续的全球供应过剩和需求疲软，加剧储存问题，将使WTI油价保持在110美元以下。
